evidence.excerpt: We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: OmniCompass defines two evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL assesses vision-language models on tasks requiring visual evidence, while OmniCompass-AV assesses omni-modal models on tasks requiring joint audio-visual evidence.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluations of 50 MLLMs show that open-source models still lag behind proprietary counterparts, particularly in audio-visual understanding.
